info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Inspections API
Get all events for an inspection

params.name: inspectionId
params.description: Inspection ID

items.docs:
Returns the timeline of events recorded against an inspection (status
changes, reminders, signature requests, reviewer activity, etc.).

The caller must already have access to the inspection — the same access
check used by `GET /v1/inspections/{inspectionId}` runs first and
surfaces the standard 404 / permission errors.

info.name: Record an event against an inspection

params.name: inspectionId
params.description: Inspection ID

items.docs:
Appends a single event to an inspection's timeline. Used by internal
surfaces (web/mobile) to record activity such as reminder sends,
signature requests, reviewer notes, etc.

The request body accepts every inspection event type except
`inspection_invitee_self_removed`, which is generated server-side.

info.name: Send reminders for one or more inspections

items.docs:
Sends an email and/or sms reminder about one or more inspection invites. The request body
groups recipients by invite; the response surfaces per-channel success and error breakdowns
so the caller can report partial failures.

info.name: Queue a manual AI damage scan for an inspection

params.name: inspectionId
params.description: Inspection ID.

items.docs:
Enqueues a manual AI damage-detection scan against a completed inspection
and returns the throttle record clients poll for progress.

Guards enforced before enqueue:
  - Caller must be on an active Pro Plan (returns 404 `subscription not found`
    when no subscription record exists, otherwise 403 with the
    Pro-Plan-required message).
  - The account must have manual AI damage detection enabled.

Update parameters of an inspection. The list of fields that can be updated depends on the current
status of the inspection: `x_id`, `inspection_label`, `archived`, `status`, and

`recipients`) can only be updated while the inspection is in the Scheduled or In-Progress states.

info.name: Remove the current renter from an inspection

params.name: inspectionId
params.description: Inspection ID

items.docs:
Removes the current performer (renter) from the inspection and records a removal reason. This is
used by the mobile flow when a resident is moving out or a duplicate invite needs to be
cleaned up. Returns 204 with no content on success.

Note: this `DELETE /v1/inspections/{inspectionId}` route is distinct from the bulk
`DELETE /v1/inspections?id[]=...` endpoint, which deletes inspections by id.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of elements in the data collection.

params.description: The page number of the collection. Zero-indexed.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Sort results by one of the available fields. `approved_date` sorts
by the approved date, falling back to the completed date when an
inspection has no approved date.

params.name: sort_type
params.description:
Sort direction. Case-insensitive: `asc`/`ASC`
and `desc`/`DESC` are all accepted.

params.name: filters[archived]
params.description:
Filter inspections by their archived status. Ignored when the caller
is a renter.

params.name: archived
params.description: Deprecated. Prefer `filters[archived]`. Legacy key still accepted.

params.name: filters[has_flags]
params.description: Filter inspections by whether they have one or more maintenance flags. `true` returns only inspections with flags; `false` returns only inspections with none.

params.name: has_flags
params.description: Deprecated. Prefer `filters[has_flags]`. Legacy key still accepted.

params.name: filters[search]
params.description: Search value matched across inspection properties.

params.name: search

params.name: filters[inspection_status][value]
params.description: Pipe-separated list of inspection status values to filter by (e.g. `Not Started|Started`). Multiple values are concatenated with `|`. Allowed values, `Scheduled`, `Not Started`, `Started`, `In Review`, `Completed`, `Awaiting Review`, `Revision Requested`, `Revision Review`, `Approved`.

params.name: filters[inspection_status][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the inspection status filter.

params.name: inspection_status[]
params.description:
Deprecated. Prefer `filters[inspection_status][value]`. Legacy
multi-value array key still accepted.

params.name: filters[inspection_template][value]
params.description: List of inspection template ids to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|`.

params.name: filters[inspection_template][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the inspection template filter.

params.name: inspection_template[]
params.description:
Deprecated. Prefer `filters[inspection_template][value]`. Legacy
multi-value array key still accepted.

params.name: filters[team][value]
params.description: List of team ids to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|`.

params.name: filters[team][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the team filter.

params.name: team_id[]
params.description:
Deprecated. Prefer `filters[team][value]`. Legacy multi-value array
key still accepted.

params.name: filters[property][value]
params.description: List of property ids to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|`.

params.name: filters[property][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the property filter.

params.name: property_id[]
params.description:
Deprecated. Prefer `filters[property][value]`. Legacy multi-value
array key still accepted.

params.name: filters[rating][value]
params.description: List of inspection ratings to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|` (e.g. `Good|Fair`). Allowed values, `Good`, `Fair`, `Poor`.

params.name: filters[rating][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the rating filter.

params.name: ratings[]
params.description:
Deprecated. Prefer `filters[rating][value]`. Legacy multi-value
array key still accepted.

params.name: filters[assigned_to][value]
params.description: List of user ids to filter inspections by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|`.

params.name: filters[assigned_to][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the assigned_to filter.

params.name: assigned_to[]
params.description:
Deprecated. Prefer `filters[assigned_to][value]`. Legacy multi-value
array key still accepted.

params.name: filters[review_step][value]
params.description: List of review steps to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|` (e.g. `Initial Review|Secondary Review`). Allowed values, `Initial Review`, `Secondary Review`.

params.name: filters[review_step][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the review step filter. The validator only accepts `any_of`.

params.name: filters[created_by][value]
params.description: List of creator user ids to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|`.

params.name: filters[created_by][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the created_by filter.

params.name: filters[due_date][start_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection effective due date by a starting date.
Must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.

params.name: filters[due_date][end_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection effective due date by an ending date.
Must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. `end_date`
must be on or after `start_date`, otherwise the response returns
`end date must be equal or after start date`.

params.name: filters[due_date_legacy][start_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection due date (pre-effective-due-date) by a starting date.
Must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Cannot be combined with
`filters[due_date]`; that combination is rejected with
`You cannot use both due_date and due_date_legacy filters at the same time`.

params.name: filters[due_date_legacy][end_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection due date (pre-effective-due-date) by an ending date.
Must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. `end_date`
must be on or after `start_date`, otherwise the response returns
`end date must be equal or after start date`. See `start_date` for the
mutually-exclusive constraint with `filters[due_date]`.

params.name: filters[completed_date][start_date]
params.description:
Value to filter completed inspection date by a starting date.
Must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.

params.name: filters[completed_date][end_date]
params.description:
Value to filter completed inspection date by an ending date.
Must be in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. `end_date`
must be on or after `start_date`, otherwise the response returns
`end date must be equal or after start date`.

Returns a paginated list of inspection digests.
V3 is intended for list views that don't need the full inspection document; it returns `api_inspection_digest` entries (a trimmed projection of `api_inspection`) and uses the nested `filters[...]` query-param syntax with flat `page_size` / `page_number` / `sort_by` / `sort_type` options.

info.name: Get inspection permissions for the current user

items.docs:
Returns the per-user permissions that drive the inspection creation and assignment UI
(e.g. whether the user can create inspections on units / buildings / communities, whether
they can assign to residents, and renter-specific flags). Used internally by the mobile
and web apps.

params.name: inspectionId
params.description: Inspection ID

items.docs:
Generates a batch of pre-signed S3 PUT URLs that the inspection performer or invitee can use to upload images, 360 images, or videos for an inspection feature. Each URL is valid for 7 days.

Only callers whose inspection role is `invitee-write` or `self-perform-write` may request URLs — owners and reviewers receive a permissions error.

The response order matches the request order one-to-one.

Resolves the set of reminder recipients across a batch of inspections.
Invites are batch-fetched once for the supplied inspection ids,
tenants are batch-fetched once for the unique recipient emails, and
the result is deduped by email.

Access is validated the same way the send-reminders path is, so the
caller can't read invite emails for inspections it can't already access.

info.name: Create signature request(s) for an inspection

params.name: inspectionId
params.description: Inspection ID

items.docs:
Creates one signature request per email in `emails`. Each request is dispatched
via email and tracked individually in the inspection timeline. The response is the
list of created requests.

Marks every open signature request on this inspection as accepted by the
authenticated recipient. Used when a single user has multiple pending requests
against the same inspection (e.g. additional-signature loops).

info.name: Complete a signature request by submitting a signature

params.name: inspectionId

items.docs:
Completes the signature request that the authenticated recipient currently has
open against this inspection. Either `signature_base64` (drawn signature image) or
`signature_text` (typed signature) must be supplied. Returns the updated list of
signature requests on the inspection.
